evidence: Read the whole diff. Every new check in parseModelTable has a matching test case: duplicate tier row, missing separator, duplicate runtime column, id with a space, table outside its heading.
The slice bound lines[header+2:] is safe because the separator check already requires header+1 < len(lines).
build() marks a table failure as parsing only when errors.As finds a *tableError, and ReadModelTable wraps only parse errors. A file read failure keeps the reading verb.
I could not see the import block of agentgen.go, so I could not confirm that errors is already imported. The new test would fail to compile if it is not.
I could not see the body of splitRow. I did not report a possible head[0] panic on a header line that is only '|', because I could not confirm it.
